note: Part: the fact that $p\mapsto(\log p)/p$ is decreasing for $p\ge3$ (`log_div_anti`, used through `shat_anti` in the exchange argument). [L] does not omit 7 or treat $210\nmid q$, and for $(p/(p-1))f_1(p)$ it proves only an antitone majorant `gHatQ` (`gp_le_ghat`, `ghat_anti`), not that the function itself decreases.

snippet.text:
theorem log_div_anti {a b : ℝ} (hb : 3 ≤ b) (hab : b ≤ a) : Real.log a / a ≤ Real.log b / b := by
  have he : Real.exp 1 ≤ 3 := (Real.exp_one_lt_d9).le.trans (by norm_num)
  exact Real.log_div_self_antitoneOn (Set.mem_Ici.2 (he.trans hb))
    (Set.mem_Ici.2 (he.trans (hb.trans hab))) hab

proof_context.conclusion: For $3\le b\le a$, $\log a/a\le\log b/b$: the map $p\mapsto(\log p)/p$ is decreasing for $p\ge3$ (via `Real.log_div_self_antitoneOn`).
